title: Is anyone waking up in the middle of the night or sleepwalking
content: As the title says, has anyone recently experienced parasomnia during sleep, including waking up from sleep in the middle of the night? I used to sleepwalk a lot as a child but the past few nights I have woken up disoriented confused and anxious and begin walking around my apartment literally just touching the walls and the floor and stuff until I wake up and then I’m scared cuz I am also tired and feel like I’m not actually sleeping when I’m asleep. I have bags under my eyes now quite prominently that I didnt have before.
